title: Aayi Darbaar Ch Jis Velay Sain Babay Di Sanad Chakay
body:
Kitti Tauheen Musalmana, Khaali Mur Aayi, Barey Darbaar Ichhon Rondi, Apnay Putaran Nu Gal Lakay
<<DIVIDER>>
Boli Syeda Mey Haan, Waris Rasool Di
Phuk Jaagera Di Nayi Menu, Meray Buhay Toun, Mangday Khairaat Vi Arshi, Akha Jibreel Nu Dasay Akay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shuru Alhamd Toh Keeta, Taruf Batool Ney
Mey Mohammed Di Sadaqat Haan, Mere Shehzaday, Lo Lo Marjan Ney Dovey, Menu Bhejo Na Jhutlakay
<<DIVIDER>>
Lakh Fidak Howan Jey, Vaara Naalain Toun
Mey Saqifay Dey Laeena Toun, Baba Naraaz Ah, Menu Jageeran Di Khatir, Jhirkan Dende Raye, Bulwakey
<<DIVIDER>>
Khum e Ghadeer Dey Badlay, Leh Laye Ney Zalimaa
Maar Chadeya Sain Zahra Nu, Naal Ey Rowan Tey, Laa Chadiyan Ney Pabandiya, Inama Da Haye Ghar Jalakay
